id: title:Gilbert09:always sweep abandoned staging siblings on clear

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and orphaned data prevention
review.reason: Adds exception handling and re-raise for own-prefix deletion while preserving sibling-sweep execution; adds test asserting sibling cleanup still runs when own-prefix deletion fails. This prevents warehouse ingestion failures from skipping cleanup of abandoned sibling prefixes, preserving the backstop against orphaned data.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a substantive, bounded correctness improvement and regression protection. The actual production benefit and adoption are not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
